curriculumHighlights.text: Data Science and Artificial Intelligence runs as its own standalone B.Tech discipline rather than a track inside Computer Science and Engineering, giving it a separate admission line and department-style identity.

curriculumHighlights.text: First-year students across every branch take a shared Applied Digital Logic Design course built around the institute's FPGA lab, so hands-on digital-hardware design is common to the whole batch, not just electronics majors.

curriculumHighlights.text: Electric Vehicle Technology is organised as its own discipline with a dedicated M.Tech, separate from the Electrical Engineering department, reflecting a deliberate push into emerging mobility technology.

curriculumHighlights.text: All undergraduates pass through a common DIY training lab covering laser cutting, CNC machining and prototyping, meant to give every branch hands-on fabrication skills before specialised coursework.

research.note: IIT Bhilai runs PhD admission as a rolling, department-wise cycle across all twelve engineering, science and liberal-arts departments rather than one annual round. Sponsored research income has grown quickly: faculty ran 143 funded projects across 34 agencies in 2024-25, more than double the 62 projects the year before, alongside a DST-backed Technology Innovation Hub for financial technology housed at the institute's own innovation foundation.
